purpose: Freeze candidate and control launch profiles before server startup or inference.
engine_version: Qwen engine 0.1.50 bundled with Strata v0.2.6; Control wrapper 0.1.51
comparability: same runtime, serving wrapper, GPU pair, context, KV policy, prefill/cache policy, sampling, port and max generation. The quant/fine-tune is the intended profile difference. No 1-GPU fallback.
gates: First run strata serve --plan --offline for both. Before actual start, re-read WORK_QUEUE/lock and check for PeritoSoft/inference servers and ports. Server startup must allocate >=1 GiB on each card; otherwise stop without score.
explicit_gpu_flag: --gpu 0,1 is added to both engine argv; serve-plan will be checked to prove no default/single-GPU fallback.
expert_profile_policy: Identical neutral 48x512 all-expert rank for both arms; generated with --no-base without traces after smoke 01 demonstrated dual-GPU layer split requires --expert-profile. Not workload-calibrated.
